programmes.d: A former neighbor of the McCains' is released from jail after serving his sentence for robbery.
When Lucas, Mark, and Micah get lost in Old Mexico, they are held hostage by a group of bandits.
While trapped in the ghost town saloon, Lucas tries to come up with a plan to escape with his son.
Lou Mallory arrives in North Fork and starts buying up land and businesses.
Lucas and several others are trapped in the hotel with a dangerous outlaw.
Gunslinger Johnny Drako rides into town and tells the bartender that he is looking for Lucas McCain.
A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory.
Lucas gets wind of an assassination.
Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle.
Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men.
When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to change his mind.
Mark takes a sudden aversion to his father's rifle after one of his friends is killed.
Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away.
While on a cougar hunt, Lucas loses faith in his ability as a rifleman.
A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas' is accused of the killing.
Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down.
The son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery comes to North Fork looking for revenge.
Bullies ridicule a Japanese visitor.
On Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch.
A snake helps a prisoner escape.
While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy.
Lucas uses a bullet as evidence to convict a crooked gambler.
Mark is injured in an accident that leaves his legs paralyzed.
A stranger arrives on the McCain ranch claiming to be a friend of Lucas'.
Lucas refuses help to an old man running from a gang of criminals.
A group of hill folk is installed as peace officers in a town near North Fork.
Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely.
Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.
Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.
When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him.
The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal.
Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch.
A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain.
A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully challenges him to a duel.
A new bank opens and Banker Hamilton hires a slow-witted gunman to guard the safe.
Mark tries to play Cupid between Lucas and a stranger who arrives in North Fork.
An arch-criminal has been run out of New Orleans and is passing through North Fork.
Young Dan Willard takes on Marshal Micah Torrence's job.
Lucas and Mark are returning from a big cattle sale when the stage is robbed by three outlaws.
Lucas suspects a nobleman, recently arrived from England, of cattle rustling.
An Argentine family moves to North Fork. The townspeople mock their clothing and customs.
Lucas and Mark find themselves exposed to anthrax when they adopt a horse.
After the Civil War, General Phil Sheridan is on an inspection tour of the New Mexico land.
Outlaws hunt a retired gunfighter who has settled in North Fork.
An old friend of Lucas McCain's, a traveling photographer, comes to North Fork plying his trade.
The townsfolk of North Fork decide to give a young couple a shivaree celebration.
